DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

I am concerned about your age combined with progressive vision loss and headache; have you noticed any jaw pain when chewing or scalp tenderness, and would you like me to immediately request an ESR and CRP blood test along with a temporal artery ultrasound?
